notes.title: Single player campaign opponent personalities!
notes.content:
[p]Some are more accurate and slower, some brute force or tactical. Discover them while playing single player campaign!

When you play, you see how the opponents play and can discover their lore friendly game styles. 

Your road to the top in Fistagon needs you to understand your opponent to play against them with the right style!

This prepares you to face multiple human opponents in multiplayer! [/p]

notes.title: Major updates as release is coming in!
notes.content:
[p]Thank you for patience! We have locked in the countries that are represented in the game !

We are also doing heavy testing for multiplayer as the game rely a lot on your will to punch your way to the top! 

Show some love and share and tell your friends that the grand tournament is on SOON! [/p]
